description.value: Cultured elastic reinforcement laid along every tendon in the leg. +5-foot status bonus to Speed; your Long Jump and High Jump distances double; you take no damage from a fall of 25 feet or less and half damage from any longer fall.

cinderfall.incomplete: Doubling Long Jump/High Jump distance and reducing fall damage both have no rule-element hook: jump distance is a fixed table lookup with no distance-multiplier rule element (confirmed real precedent, Boots of Bounding, only ever grants an Athletics check bonus, never a distance multiplier), and fall-damage reduction has zero precedent anywhere -- the real Cat Fall feat (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/skill/level-1/cat-fall.json) makes an equally concrete claim and ships rules: [] too.
